01 / Profile

About me

A concise overview of my background, interests and the kind of engineering work I enjoy.

I am Kondabattini Nithin Kumar, a Computer Science and Engineering student at SR University, Warangal, pursuing my B.Tech from 2023 to 2027. My academic CGPA is 8.34/10.

My primary interest is full-stack development: designing user interfaces, building APIs, connecting databases and integrating useful AI capabilities. I work with JavaScript, Python and Java, and have hands-on experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, SQL and MongoDB.

I enjoy building end-to-end projects rather than isolated demos. My portfolio includes business intelligence workflows, computer-vision annotation, financial-risk analysis, civic transparency, sustainability dashboards, analytics case studies and real-time web applications.

I am also interested in cloud technologies, DevOps practices, automation, prompt engineering and applied machine learning. I value readable code, practical problem-solving, clear documentation and interfaces that make complex workflows easier to understand.
